display.purpose: The one big statement on a photo or hero area.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Colour and small position changes on hover and focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-arrow { color: var(--arrow-peach); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Text or password field with an optional action inside.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--field-line); background: var(--white); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: var(--focus-glow); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-field button { min-width: 57px; align-self: stretch; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field button:hover { color: var(--orange-dark); }

components.name: Segmented Options
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; background: var(--track); } .ds-segmented span { display: grid; min-height: 42px; place-items: center; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--ink-soft); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-segmented .ds-segmented-on { background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); }

components.name: Form Message
components.description: Error or notice shown under a form field.
components.css: .ds-form-message { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-left: 3px solid var(--orange); background: var(--alert-tint); color: var(--alert-text); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Brand Lockup
components.description: Orange H mark with the HUDDLE wordmark.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; width: 42px; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; background: var(--orange); color: var(--white); font-family: var(--display-font); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-brand-name { font-family: var(--display-font); font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; }

components.name: Kicker Label
components.description: Small capital label above the login heading. Login page only.
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0; color: var(--green); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Compact Button
components.description: Page actions and links that act as buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-compact { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-compact:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green); } .ds-btn-compact:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary and repeated actions in lists.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--field-line); background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 7px; background: var(--green); color: var(--white); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-tag-muted { background: var(--track); color: var(--ink-soft); }

narrative.overview:
Huddle looks like the board the team gathers around before a game: an off-white surface, dark marker ink, one orange marker for the thing that matters. It is made for the team only, so nothing on it is selling anything. Headings are tall and condensed like a scoreboard; everything else is small, plain and quiet.

The mood is focused and no-nonsense. A player opens Huddle to learn a play, usually on a phone, often minutes before training. Pages are calm, sharp and practical. Edges are square. Colour is used sparingly, and decoration is limited to one faint dot grid on the board surface and the team photo on the login page.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white board surface with dark green-black ink, never pure white or pure black.
Tall condensed headings (Barlow Condensed) over small, plain body text (DM Sans).
One orange accent, used in small amounts.
Mostly flat surfaces; light shadows are allowed where they help show what is raised or selected.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange is the only loud colour. It marks one or two small things per screen (brand mark, focus, an alert edge). It is never a page background, a card fill or a gradient.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Colours, fonts and shadows are defined in `app/static/css/tokens.css` and used through `var(--name)`. The one exception is the dark gradient over the login photo, which lives in `pages/login.css`.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is for headings and the wordmark only. Anything longer than a short line, and every control, is DM Sans.

rules.name: The Capitals Are Typed Rule
rules.body: Kickers and the wordmark are written in capitals in the HTML. There is no `text-transform` and no extra letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Light Touch Rule
rules.body: A shadow is never darker than 12% Marker Ink and never wider than a few pixels. If a surface needs a heavy shadow to stand out, change its background tone or add a line.

dos: Do use the colours and fonts from `tokens.css` through `var(--name)`.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius).
Do put one Barlow Condensed heading on a page and let DM Sans do the rest.
Do keep controls at least 42px tall so they are easy to tap on a phone.
Do keep the 2px Court Orange focus outline on anything that can be focused.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; transitions are 160ms and only change colour or nudge position.
Do keep text at WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Marker Ink, Ink Soft, Locker Green and Muted Grey all pass on Board White and Paper. Court Orange does not pass as text: use Court Orange Deep or Alert Text.
Do give repeated buttons a full `aria-label` ("Deactivate Wei Jie"), so screen readers can tell the rows apart.
donts: Don't use purple, gradients as decoration, or any accent colour other than Court Orange.
Don't use emoji as icons; icons are custom SVGs in `app/static/icons/`.
Don't round corners or turn buttons into pills.
Don't use heavy or coloured drop shadows.
Don't set body text, labels or controls in Barlow Condensed.
Don't use pure black (`#000`) or pure white (`#fff`) for surfaces.
Don't fill large areas with Court Orange.
Don't add a kicker label above headings on new pages.
